thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: streaming-v2 cluster (us-west-2) reporting sustained tail latency -> p95=1.2s p99=3.8s over the last 5m. Errors (5xx) rising to 1.8%. SLOs breached for streaming responses. Paging on-call @oncall-jay and SRE rotation.

oncall-jay: ack, I'm on it. pulling up dashboards and recent deploys. any customer-facing pages yet?

sre-anne: I'm seeing a sudden increase in long-lived connections and stalled chunk writes from the proxy layer (nginx-streamer). Many clients show long write times to socket.

eng-platform-mike: no deploys in last 30m. autoscaler hasn't acted because instance cpu is low but net IO queue is growing.

infra-ops: noticed a spike in socket CLOSE_WAIT counts on gateway nodes ~10:12UTC, correlate?

oncall-jay: copying metrics, running quick q: `kubectl logs -n infra gateway-0 -f --since=10m | grep chunk`

oncall-jay: logs show repeated `Write timeout to client` and `client backpressure threshold exceeded` messages.

prod-qa: reproducing locally with a long SSE stream (10k tokens) we see chunk buffering at the proxy when a slow client stops consuming.

support-lina: we've got 3 escalations from customers reporting stalls and partial responses, one on payments flow (customer id: C-879). Not widespread yet but high severity if payments hang.

eng-platform-mike: hypothesizing: proxy keepalive / write timeout too aggressive combined with connection-level queuing -> causes head-of-line for other streams multiplexed on same worker.

sre-anne: quick mitigation proposal: 1) increase proxy_per_worker_write_timeout to 30s, 2) enable per-connection write backpressure metrics and drop connections with >30s stall, 3) route traffic away from overloaded gateway nodes.

infra-ops: preparing to drain gateway-2 and split traffic across gateway-{0,1,3}. executing `kubectl cordon gateway-2 && kubectl drain gateway-2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` (rolling).

oncall-jay: applying temporary QOS rule to reduce outstanding streaming_window per client: `streaming_window_max=4` to avoid one client hogging worker. Pushing config now.

(2m later)

incident-bot: Update: routing change in progress, 25% traffic moved off gateway-2. Keepalive increased on gateway config in prod.

prod-qa: after draining gateway-2 I'm seeing p99 drop from ~3.8s to ~1.4s on the test baseline. still seeing a few tails at ~2.2s.

support-lina: customer C-879 confirms payments resumed after ~40s stall; they saw a partial retry succeed. No data loss.

sre-anne: recommend enabling fallback pool (dedicated smaller instance group) for long running streams while we stabilize proxy config. eng-platform, can we shift streaming-heavy routes to fallback?

eng-platform-mike: yes, can create a routing rule: if route.tags contains `streaming-long` -> route to fallback-pool. Deploying now.

(5m later)

incident-bot: Mitigation in effect: streaming-heavy routes routed to fallback-pool, gateway-2 drained, proxy timeouts increased, streaming_window_max lowered. p95 now 520ms, p99 1.1s, errors down to 0.3%.

oncall-jay: marking incident as MITIGATED for immediate customer impact. Will keep monitoring for 30m, then hand to follow-up.

prod-qa: capturing sample request traces and saved a reproducible repro. Attaching trace IDs: trace-4829, trace-4830. These show socket write stalls when downstream client stops reading.

sre-anne: immediate action items: (1) create postmortem with timeline and root-cause next 6h, (2) add a short-term rate limit on outstanding streaming chunks per connection, (3) add synthetic streaming test that simulates slow clients to catch regressions.

eng-platform-mike: longer term: redesign proxy write path to use backpressure-aware SST (stream selective transfer) and move away from single-worker multiplexing for heavy streams. Adding to backlog.

support-lina: will notify affected customers (C-879 and two others) that incident is mitigated and we'll follow up with RCA.

customer-success-amy: prepping a customer note template with timeline and known impact (up to 40s stalls, ~5% requests affected at peak).

infra-ops: gateway-2 remains cordoned and will rejoin after config tweak verification. scheduling a redeploy with updated keepalive and buffering knobs at 11:10UTC.

oncall-jay: closing active page. severity: P2 (external impact but bounded). filing a follow-up checklist in issues/IN-2147.

sre-anne: tagging this thread for postmortem. Will add graphs (p50/p95/p99) and heap of connection metrics.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated). Remember to complete follow-up tasks and retro in 24h.
